fields.description: Issue dated April 20, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 31). Front-page political commentary criticizes Governor David Sholtz’s proposed statewide sales tax and legislative practices, praising Representative Dan Chappell’s planned radio address and opposing chain-store dominance through discussion of a proposed “Florida Recovery Act.” Local politics coverage includes the crowded Miami city commission race and candidate mentions. Additional content includes columns and advertisements, extensive horse-racing “Jockey Jimmy” tip material, sports talk (including Babe Ruth), a proposal for a 1936 Pan-American exposition in Miami, commentary on small-loan companies and interest rates, notices about Easter sunrise travel to Miami Beach, and a warning about Miami High School students hitchhiking.
